trigger: The first grey snow, late July. Chapter end decision.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's snowing in July. The flakes are grey and they don't melt right. They smear.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: it smells like a campfire. like the whole world's a campfire.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: My dear. Some of us cannot walk twenty miles. Some of us will not leave the block.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: With no running dam, there is no warm place upriver. You stay. Everyone stays.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The dam is warm. The city has the Harbor's grain, if there is any. You can't have both.

choices.text: We go to the dam. Now, before the cold.
We stay. We hold the block together.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Then go. I will keep the clinic. Someone has to be here when people knock.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You load the sled. Theo carries the cooler. Marguerite waves from her porch.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Come back for me in a month. If I'm being stubborn, come anyway. You understand?

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Good. We'll make this street a village. It almost already is.
